parsed.reason: The message covers what an approval_card needs. It gives the window, the correct date and time (Tuesday, September 15 at 7:00 a.m.), Max and Mia, and the link. It says plainly that Hale never registers. It lists all four texts with the right timings and includes the course-link tip correctly. It asks no question, and the general public opening 7 days later is a handed fact. The near_band note is a fair plain restatement. One weakness: 'Residents get their date first' is vague. It does not clearly say that September 15 is this family's own residents-first date from their postal code, so a reader could wonder whether the family qualifies. Slightly stiff in places.
